decided_by: user: precision raised to 0.75 on 2026-10-08 after the heldout-1 verdict; every other value is the user-approved round-2 choice

search.order: displayed: the MCP search render order (directory-diversified detail head)

effect.population: medium and complex cases of the target whose baseline search (all terms joined by spaces) misses every gold path in its top_k; M = their count
effect.rule: recovered_beyond_control >= ceil(M / 3) per target in judged_mode
effect.recovered_beyond_control: a suggested query's top_k holds a gold path and neither the baseline nor the first k control queries (k = number of suggested queries) do
effect.when_M_is_zero: not measurable; reported as such, not as a pass

precision.population: every related term the judged_mode block showed (label-queue.jsonl), labeled once by codex gpt-6.1-sol with the v1 label set, judged in the case prompt's context
precision.rule: useful / labeled >= 0.75, pooled over both targets and reported per target

hard_limits.rule: in every mode and case: block_bytes <= 2048 and no identifier-shaped term expanded

secondary_reporting: reported, not judged: control (query plan with input terms only) recoveries over the baseline, and the same counts for the dictionary and morphology modes
